title: The Public API cannot set a work order's Bill To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Send the Public API request that updates work order 1, with a Bill To of customer C.
  2. Send GET for work order 1 through the Public API.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The update does not set the Bill To (it is refused or the Bill To value is ignored).

Step 2:

  • The Bill To still names customer B, and the customer fields still name customer A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12321 (Story 19, IBS, invoice export and Public API)

  • S19-N3: “The Public API cannot set a Bill To or read a saved default.”
  • Out of Scope: “Setting a Bill To through the Public API. Read and filter only.”
